· AMENDMENT 2026-08-01 — Lowered floors pages_total (292 -> 291) and corpora_pages.workbench
(2 -> 1).: A forensic pass held all 292 published pages against the commit each citation names
and found ONE whose published bytes were an uncommitted working-tree edit published under a
commit sha that does not contain them (workbench/living-science-walkthrough). The ingest now
fences any document whose own bytes are uncommitted, per path, so it cannot assert a provenance
it does not have. The page count falls by one because a page that was making a false claim
stopped being published. This is a REDUCTION IN COUNT AND AN INCREASE IN CORRECTNESS, which is
why the floor is lowered deliberately rather than the fence being weakened to preserve a number.
The remaining four fenced documents return the moment the workbench worktree is committed.
COVERAGE 100%.
